newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Archbishop Tutu's son arrested by S.African police.
newsitem.headline: Archbishop Tutu's son arrested by S.African police.

text.p: Nobel peace laureate Archbishop Desmond Tutu's son was arrested on Friday after a four-year chase by South African police for making a bomb threat at an airport in 1989, police said.
A warrant for the arrest of Trevor Tutu, 41, was issued in 1993 when he skipped bail after his appeal against a 3-1/2-year jail sentence for the bomb threat failed.

"Tutu was arrested...at about midday and will soon appear in...court to face the charges against him and where it will be decided whether he should serve his sentence or not," police said in a statement.
Archbishop Tutu, chairman of South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission, is undergoing medical treatment in the United States for prostate cancer.
